title: pvPointSource
body:
## pvPointSource

Creates a cloud of NumberOfPoints points placed pseudo-randomly with uniform density inside a sphere of radius Radius around Center, as polydata vertices. Use it as a seed cloud for streamlines or particle tracing, or as test input. With the ParaView defaults (one point, radius 0) it yields a single point at the centre.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Positions come from VTK's pseudo-random generator; do not rely on identical positions across sessions or ParaView versions.
- Radius 0 puts every point at the centre; set a radius when you need a spread.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `PointSource`. Identity: `sources/PointSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates of the center of the point cloud. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `NumberOfPoints` | This property specifies the number of points in the point cloud. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Radius` | This property specifies the radius of the point cloud, measured from the value of the Center property. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

  "mode": "serial",
